question: A customer wants to offload some of its order processing to a public cloud environment. The customer environment is based on Cisco ACI and uses Puppet with containerized applications. The operations team requires a solution to orchestrate and optimize the cost of the new solution. Which product must be used to meet these requirements?
theory: Cisco Workload Optimization Manager continuously analyzes real-time demand across compute, storage and application layers and automatically resizes or moves workloads to control cost while assuring performance — exactly the 'orchestrate and optimize cost' requirement here. CloudCenter focuses on deploying and moving applications across clouds rather than ongoing cost/performance right-sizing, Intersight is Cisco's SaaS infrastructure management platform, and DCNM only manages the network fabric, so none of them directly deliver continuous workload cost optimization. (Cisco documentation / web research)
